name: 52317 · North Liberty, IA
findings: ZIP 52317 (North Liberty) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52317 (North Liberty) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 52317 (North Liberty) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 14% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 65% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
